header.title: My Collections
header.subtitle: Manage your collections and keep your different collecting goals organized.

empty.description: Collections are created automatically when you add a figurine to one. Open any figurine and use Add to Collection to create your first collection.

overview.title: Collections Overview
overview.description: Track your collections as they grow and compare what is unique versus repeated. "Total entries" counts every figurine placement in every collection, while "Unique figurines" counts each figurine only once. Counts include both upcoming reserved releases and items already in hand when available in your collections.

totalCollections.label: Total collections
totalCollections.tooltip: How many different collections you currently have.

totalFigurineEntries.label: Total figurine entries
totalFigurineEntries.tooltip: Counts all placements, including upcoming reserved releases and already-owned released figures. If the same figurine appears in 3 collections, it counts as 3 entries.

uniqueFigurines.label: Unique figurines
uniqueFigurines.tooltip: Counts each figurine only once, even if it appears in multiple collections.

averageFigurinesPerCollection.label: Average per collection
averageFigurinesPerCollection.tooltip: Average number of figurines per collection = total figurine entries divided by total collections.

repeatedEntries.label: Repeated entries across collections: {{total}}
repeatedEntries.repetitions: (same figurine appears in more than one collection).

largestCollection.title: Largest Collections by Figurine Count
largestCollection.tooltip: Shows up to 5 collections ordered by figurine count. Longer bars mean more figurines in that collection.

uniqueFigurinesRatio.title: Unique Figurines Ratio
uniqueFigurinesRatio.tooltip: Percent of entries that are unique: unique figurines divided by total figurine entries.
uniqueFigurinesRatio.footer_one: {{count}} unique figurine out of {{entries}} total entries.
uniqueFigurinesRatio.footer_other: {{count}} unique figurines out of {{entries}} total entries.

dialogDelete.title: Delete Collection?
dialogDelete.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"?
dialogDelete.description2: This action cannot be undone. Deleting this collection will permanently remove it, along with all the figurines you've added to it.
dialogDelete.description3: If you want to organize those figurines again, you'll need to create a new collection and add them manually.
